blocks.text: Network performance means how well a network works: the speed and quality of data transfer. Good performance gives fast, smooth communication; poor performance causes slow Internet and delays. Performance depends on many factors, such as bandwidth and latency.

blocks.caption: Bandwidth and latency
rows: The amount of data that can be sent in a given time: how much data the network can carry
The time data takes to travel: the delay between sending and receiving
Low bandwidth, or many devices sharing it, makes the Internet slow
High latency causes lag; online games and video calls need low latency

items: Too many users on the network.
